team: Will is off the mark with a solid Monday in the books, while Fred's week 1 log is still blank. Fred, get Tuesday's 400s logged and the race is on.

fred.headline: Week 1 starts now, log it
fred.summary: No sessions or benchmarks logged yet, so there is nothing to grade. That is fine on day one. The goal this week is simple: tick off the sessions and log every one so the coach has numbers to work with.
strengths: Plan is set: 27 weeks to Brisbane with a clear 1:25 target
Monday checklist opened, so you are already in the app
weaknesses: No logged sessions yet this week
No benchmarks recorded, so starting level is unknown
tips: Log every session right after you finish: duration, run km, RPE and knee score take 30 seconds.
Tuesday is 6 x 400 m at 5k pace with 90 s rest. Aim for even splits, not a hero first rep.
Record your weights in the notes (e.g. Loads (kg): Trap bar 100 (3/3)) so next week's loads can be set for you.

will.headline: Strong start, time to add weight
will.summary: You logged Monday: 40 min, 1 km at 5:30 per km, RPE 3, knee 2. Trap bar and sled at 90 lb felt easy, so there is room to load up. Keep logging Tue, Thu, Fri and Sat to hit the 8 km run target for week 1.
strengths: First session done on day one, straight onto the plan
1 km at 5:30 per km is already faster than 1:25 goal pace (about 5:53 per km)
RPE 3 means the strength work has plenty of headroom
weaknesses: Only 1 of 8 km run so far this week
Knee at 2 already in week 1, worth watching on lunges and sled
tips: Put Monday loads in the notes like this: Loads (lb): Trap bar 90 (3/3) · Sled push 90 (emom). It lets the coach track sets and EMOM rest properly.
If knee pain reaches 4 on any station, stop that station and swap to sled push or step ups. Get the MCL looked at before week 9 if it keeps showing up.
Saturday half sim at 75%: keep the four 500 m runs within 10 to 15 s of each other.

tweaks.text: RPE 3 at 90 lb means go heavier: trap bar DL 3 x 5 at 100 lb and sled push at 110 lb.
